description: This file defines a utility class 'Paginator' for handling list pagination logic within the OFBiz widget rendering framework. It includes methods for calculating indices, list sizes, and preparing pagers for paginating data in UI components.

classes.name: Paginator
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing list pagination, including calculating page indices, sizes, and preparing pager components.

methods.name: getActualPageSize
methods.description: Retrieve the actual size of the current page from context or compute based on high and low indices.

methods.name: getHighIndex
methods.description: Get the high index (exclusive upper bound) for pagination from context.

methods.name: getListLimits
methods.description: Determine and set pagination limits (low/high index, list size, view index and size) in the context based on the provided list or iterator.

methods.name: getListSize
methods.description: Retrieve the total list size from context.

methods.name: getLowIndex
methods.description: Get the low index (inclusive lower bound) for pagination from context.

methods.name: getViewIndex
methods.description: Determine the current view (page) index from model form and context.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Determine the number of items per page (view size) from model form and context.

methods.name: preparePager
methods.description: Initialize pagination parameters and set up list limits and indices based on the list or iterator in the context.

methods.name: safeNext
methods.description: Safely get the next element from an iterator, returning null if no elements remain.

methods.name: getViewIndex
methods.description: Retrieve the view index from context with a default fallback.

methods.name: getViewIndex (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieve the view index from context with a specified default.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Retrieve the view size from context with fallback to default property value.
